summary: Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc filed a Form 6-K under Rule 13a-16/15d-16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, attaching a press release dated August 17, 2026. The release discloses that Non-Executive Director and Chairman Mr July Ndlovu purchased 21,400 common shares on August 13, 2026 at $23.03 per share on NYSE American, increasing his holdings to 250,489 shares. This is a routine director share-dealing notification under MAR (UK PDMR rules), not a special situation. The filing is informational only, with no corporate action, transaction, or strategic event involved. It represents standard insider-transaction disclosure, requiring no board recommendation, advisors, or deal mechanics. Watch: none — purely routine compliance disclosure, reflecting ordinary market purchases by a board member, with no impact on the company's corporate structure or strategy.
